confirmed_defect: The aggregate left the PCFG application conditional; its requested positive-mass equal-pair supplier and exact prefix conditioning were absent. The original all-p finite-word formulation is impossible for p>1/2, and the finite-mean argument excludes the critical p=1/2 unnecessarily.
smallest_missing_prerequisite: lem-2dyck-pcfg-prefix-mass-positive: exact stream/finite-word prefix law and a uniform disjoint equal-mass pairing.
resolution: For the original independent grammar read as a finite-or-infinite stream, prefix cylinder weights are (p/2)^o(1-p)^c; D_{p,k} conditions only on at least k emitted bracket tokens. Append two opens and the matching inner close to every length k−3 prefix. Its total conditional mass is p²(1−p)s_{p,k−3}/s_{p,k}≥p²(1−p). Flip the outer opening at k−2 to obtain disjoint equal-mass pairs with swapped deterministic closing types. The existing conditional loss lemma gives an unconditional gap p²(1−p)²log2 for every p∈(0,1). Termination conditioning yields the exact parameter a=min(p,1−p) and the same all-p finite-word gap in a.
preservation: No narrowed parameter range; critical case and supercritical case are covered with honest law distinctions. Hard limits, soft parity, Yun universality, architecture definitions and all other ready carriers remain unchanged. The existing paired-prefix loss lemma is unchanged.
